title: 第二十四章 优雅永不过时
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
众人基本到齐后，七长老清了清嗓子，将众人目光引至自身。

    “此番外出交流，除路线由宗门拟定外，其余诸事皆需尔等自行担待。行程时日、所需资材，乃至途中突发状况，均须尔等自行筹划应对。此本也是宗门对你们的一重考校。至于老夫，只在尔等性命攸关之时方会出手。”

    言罢，七长老便不再多话，退至一旁静立，显然不打算再行干涉。

    不过队伍并未沉寂太久。

    因季南北极为自然地接过了七长老的话头，开口说道:

    “七师伯既已明言，弟子便斗胆暂且担起领队之责。若后续安排有何不妥，诸位皆可提出，我等共商对策。不知各位意下如何?“

    众弟子皆摇头示意，并无异议。

    这般情形在其他宗门并不常见弟子之间多有竞争，往往互不服气。

    然而仙灵剑宗却非如此。

    只因“小剑仙”此名号，便代表着镇压同代的实力。

    萧京溪虽平日深居简出，在门内的威望却早已拉满。

    见此情景，七长老不由微微颔首。

    心下暗忖:本宗真是福缘深厚，前有剑青城横空出世，硬生生将仙灵剑宗推至天下第一宗之位;后继又有萧京溪这般弟子，天资卓绝，更难得的是能服众。

    然而这位长老并不知晓

    若让萧京溪自己来主持，只怕场面当场便会僵住。

    她莫说组织调度，能不临场逃开，便算万幸!

    闲言少叙。

    很快，这支仙灵剑宗的队伍便启程出发。

    一行人离了宗门，七长老旋即隐去踪迹，显然是遁入暗处随行护持，若非出事，绝不会显露身形。

    否则，此行未免太过轻松。

    带着一位化神真君招摇过市，谁还敢生什么事端?

    因队伍中众人修为参差不齐，外门弟子大抵仅有练气、筑基期的境界。

    内门弟子虽皆已筑基，但层次亦不算高。

    而御空飞遁，唯有筑基境方可行之。

    故众人起初以为，季南北会安排大家徒步前行。

    不料季南北直接令众人结对组队。

    由她这位金丹巅峰携带两位练气师妹汪天韵与白洁则各带一名练气境外门弟子。
content_en:
After everyone was almost there, the seventh elder cleared his throat and drew everyone's attention to him.

    "Except for the route planned by the sect for this outing, all other matters need to be taken care of by you. The travel time, materials required, and even emergencies on the way must be planned and dealt with by yourself. This is also a test for you by the sect. As for me, I will only take action when your lives are at stake."

    After saying this, the seventh elder stopped talking and stood aside quietly, obviously not intending to interfere anymore.

    However, the team did not remain silent for long.

    Yin Jinanji naturally took over the seventh elder's words and said:

    "Since the seventh uncle has made it clear, this disciple has the courage to temporarily take on the responsibility of leading the team. If there are any problems with the follow-up arrangements, you can all raise them and we will discuss countermeasures together. What do you think?"

    All the disciples shook their heads and had no objection.

    This kind of situation is not common in other sects. There is often competition between disciples, and they are often not convinced by each other.

    However, the Fairy Sword Sect is not like this.

    Just because the name "Little Sword Immortal" represents the strength to suppress his contemporaries.

    Although Xiao Jingxi usually lives in seclusion, his prestige within the family has already been fully achieved.

    Seeing this scene, the seventh elder couldn't help but nodded slightly.

    I secretly thought to myself: Our sect is really blessed with deep blessings. Before us, Jian Qingcheng came out of nowhere and pushed the Xianling Sword Sect to the number one sect in the world. After us, we have disciples like Xiao Jingxi who are extremely talented, and even more rare is the ability to convince everyone.

    However, this elder did not know

    If Xiao Jingxi was allowed to host it, the scene would freeze on the spot.

    Not to mention organizing and dispatching, she would be lucky if she could not escape on the spot!

    Less gossip.

    Soon, the team of the Immortal Sword Sect set off.

    The group of people left the sect, and the seventh elder immediately disappeared. He had obviously gone into the darkness to protect them, and would never have been revealed unless something went wrong.

    Otherwise, this trip would be too easy.

    Who would dare to cause any trouble when he parades through the city with a god-incarnation true king?

    Because the cultivation levels of everyone in the team are uneven, the outer disciples are mostly in the Qi training and foundation building stages.

    Although the inner disciples have all established foundations, their levels are not very high.

    As for flying in the air, it can only be done in the foundation-building realm.

    Therefore, everyone initially thought that Ji Nanbei would arrange for everyone to go on foot.

    Unexpectedly, Ji Nanbei directly ordered everyone to form a team.

    She, the peak golden elixir master, will lead two qi-training junior sisters Wang Tianyun and Bai Jie, and each will lead a qi-training foreign sect disciple.
title_en: Chapter 24 Elegance never goes out of style
